title: Advanced Inversion
completion_message: ¡Soberbio! Has dominado la Inversión Avanzada. Esta es la marca definitiva de un inglés de altísimo nivel, muy utilizado en discursos, presentaciones y escritura corporativa formal.

parts.visual:
Para dar mucho énfasis o en contextos muy formales, ponemos un adverbio negativo al principio de la oración. Al hacerlo, debemos invertir el sujeto y el verbo auxiliar (como en una pregunta). 
Normal: We have NEVER seen such profits. 
Inversión: NEVER HAVE WE seen such profits. (NUNCA HEMOS visto tales ganancias). 
Normal: You should contact the press under NO circumstances. 
Inversión: UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCES SHOULD YOU contact the press.
parts.audio: To add strong emphasis or in very formal contexts, we put a negative adverb at the beginning of the sentence. When we do this, we must invert the subject and the auxiliary verb, just like in a question. Normal sentence: We have never seen such profits. Inversion: Never have we seen such profits. Another example: Under no circumstances should you contact the press.

parts.visual:
Otras expresiones comunes de inversión: 
- Hardly / Scarcely ... when (Apenas... cuando). 
Ej: HARDLY HAD I arrived WHEN the meeting started. (Apenas había llegado cuando...). 
- Not only ... but also (No solo... sino también). 
Ej: NOT ONLY IS HE the CEO, BUT he ALSO owns the company. 
- Little (Poco / Nada). 
Ej: LITTLE DID WE know that the market would crash. (Poco sabíamos que...).
parts.audio: Other common inversion expressions. Hardly or Scarcely followed by 'when' means 'apenas... cuando'. For example: Hardly had I arrived when the meeting started. 'Not only... but also'. For example: Not only is he the C E O, but he also owns the company. 'Little' means 'poco'. For example: Little did we know that the market would crash. Notice how 'Little we knew' becomes 'Little did we know'.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la estructura invertida correcta para dar un tono formal y enfático.

questions.question: Never ____ such a terrible mistake in my life. (Nunca he cometido).
questions.explanation: Inversión de Present Perfect: Never + have I + participio.

questions.question: Under no circumstances ____ open this confidential file. (Bajo ninguna circunstancia debes tú).
questions.explanation: Inversión de modal: Under no circumstances + should + you + open.

questions.question: Not only ____ late, but he also forgot the presentation. (No solo llegó tarde).
questions.explanation: Inversión en Past Simple: Not only + did + he + arrive.

questions.question: Hardly ____ the office when the phone rang. (Apenas había yo llegado).
questions.explanation: Hardly suele usarse con Past Perfect: Hardly + had I + participio.

questions.question: Little ____ that the company was going bankrupt. (Poco sabíamos nosotros).
questions.explanation: Inversión con 'Little' en pasado: Little + did + we + know.

questions.question: Rarely ____ such dedication in a new employee. (Raramente vemos).
questions.explanation: Inversión en Present Simple: Rarely + do + we + see.

questions.question: No sooner ____ the deal than the market crashed. (Apenas habíamos firmado... cuando).
At no time ____ informed about the risks. (En ningún momento fui yo informado).
questions.explanation: Inversión con verbo To Be: At no time + was I + participio pasivo.

questions.question: Not until last week ____ that the CEO had resigned. (No fue hasta la semana pasada que descubrimos).
Only then ____ how serious the problem was. (Solo entonces me di cuenta).
On no account ____ to anyone about this project. (Bajo ningún concepto debes tú hablar).
Not only ____ our main competitor, but they also stole our clients. (No solo compraron).
questions.explanation: Inversión en Pasado Simple: Not only + did they buy.

questions.question: Hardly had we started the meeting ____ the fire alarm went off. (Apenas... cuando).
questions.explanation: La estructura correcta es: Hardly... when. (No sooner usa 'than').

questions.question: No sooner had he left the room ____ people started talking about him. (Apenas... cuando/que).
questions.explanation: La estructura correcta es: No sooner... than.

questions.question: Scarcely ____ the project when the budget was cut. (Apenas habíamos empezado).
questions.explanation: Scarcely + had + sujeto + participio (igual que Hardly).

questions.question: In no way ____ responsible for this failure. (De ninguna manera soy yo).
questions.explanation: In no way + verbo to be + sujeto: am I.

questions.question: Only by working hard ____ this goal. (Solo trabajando duro lograremos).
questions.explanation: Only by [acción] + auxiliar + sujeto: will we achieve.

questions.question: Never before ____ such an arrogant person! (Nunca antes he conocido).
Not a single word ____ during the entire meeting. (Ni una sola palabra dijo ella).
questions.explanation: Not a single word + did she say.

questions.question: Little ____ that his email was being monitored. (Poco sospechaba él).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe las palabras auxiliares invertidas. Ejemplo: 'did I' o 'have we'.

questions.question: Never ____ seen this. (he yo - Present Perfect)
Under no circumstances ____ open it. (debes tú - Modal)
Not only ____ arrive late, but... (él llegó - Past Simple con D)
Hardly ____ arrived when... (había yo - Past Perfect)
Little ____ know. (sabíamos nosotros - Past Simple)
Rarely ____ see such things. (vemos nosotros - Present Simple)
At no time ____ informed. (fui yo - To Be en pasado)
Only then ____ realize. (me di cuenta yo - Past Simple)
In no way ____ responsible. (soy yo - To Be en presente)
Only by trying ____ win. (ganaremos nosotros - Future will)

pairs.source: No sooner had we finished than...

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la estructura de inversión correcta.

options: Never have I seen such a mistake.
Never I have seen such a mistake.
Never did I see such a mistake.
Never I saw such a mistake.
questions.correct_answer: Never have I seen such a mistake.
